prompt:
Use the attached clay render as the exact blueprint. Keep every wall, opening, window, cornice, skirting, floor and ceiling line, the camera height, lens and angle, and the position, size and angle of every furniture piece and built-in exactly as in the clay. Move, resize, add or remove nothing. Each placeholder shape in the clay marks one product listed below; render it there at the stated size. Only turn the clay into real materials and light. The other attached images are close-ups of the exact products: match their form, colour and texture. Positions are fractions of frame width (x) and height (y) from the top-left.

1. PHOTO. Top Scandinavian interiors magazine: a Nordic master bedroom, 3 pm mid-winter, 24 mm shift lens at 1.05 m, level, one-point symmetric, all sharp. Hero at first glance, dead centre: the bed wall as a sanctuary, two prints between a pair of glowing wall lamps over white panelling. The cut bed foot is the foreground.

2. LIGHT. One key: soft north daylight from the window on the left wall, no sun; outside, bare birches, no snow, no buildings. Exposed for white: the bed wall by the left corner clean white, a step under the glowing reveal; the glass brightest, detailed. Light rakes across the bed from the left: every linen crinkle reads, the bed's right side a stop darker; the bed wall falls off half a stop to the right; fine shadow lines in the panelling grooves. Dense contact shadows under nightstands and bed. Ceiling a touch darker, darkest top right. Real contrast, never milky. 4600 K: whites white, never cream, pink or grey. Lamps 2700 K, low, shadowless: the two wall lamps glow through their fabric and lay small warm pools on the nightstand tops and soft fans on the panelling.

3. MATERIALS. Matte mineral paint #F4F1EC; bed wall panelled to 1.25 m in painted warm-white tongue-and-groove, slim oak cap. Wide oiled white-oak planks, pale honey #D6BF9E. Bed, headboard, nightstands: oiled oak #C8A27A, satin sheen, a long soft window highlight along the nightstand tops.

4. PRODUCTS, one per line, each on its clay placeholder:
a. ART, x 0.39-0.61, y 0.14-0.32: two 50 x 50 prints 10 cm apart, calm black ink brush abstracts on cream in very wide warm-white mats, thin matte black frames, no glare.
b. WALL LAMPS at x 0.24-0.29 and 0.71-0.76, just above the panelling cap: two flush beige linen-look wave lamps, each half a nightstand's width, hardwired.
c. CURTAIN, cut by the left edge: near stack of sheer natural linen-blend panels, S-fold, hem on the floor, backlit, clearly overlapping the left nightstand.
d. SILL VASE, x 0.06-0.09, at the far end of the sill against the jamb: one 25 cm cream fluted column vase on a turned foot, one sage branch; nothing else on the sill.
e. PLANTER, cut by the right edge: natural seagrass belly pot cover, a tall olive tree, crown below 1.75 m.
f. NIGHTSTAND VASE, left: 24 cm handmade sand-beige wabi-sabi bottle vase, matte, two dry stems.
g. DISH beside it: palm-sized speckled charcoal oval dish, empty.
h. CANDLE HOLDERS, right nightstand: two hand-sized honed travertine pedestals, unlit candles 15 and 10 cm.
i. PILLOWS: two natural washed-linen pillowcases.
j. DUVET: natural washed-linen cover, soft creases.
k. LUMBAR centred on the pillows: one 30 x 50 warm-white boucle cushion.
l. THROW across the cut foot: mist-grey cotton-linen folded into a band a quarter of the bed's length.

5. NOT IN FRAME: floor lamp, tray, carafe, glass, books, phones, clocks, rug, basket, ceiling lamp, socket, cable, text, people. No sun patches, beams, bloom, haze, halos, HDR, grain or vignette.

grade.rule: docs/render-recipe-nordic-2026-10-24.md 2.6 (the Bible grade): WB on the hero-wall patch, exposure capped +-0.2 stop, chroma -10%, roll-off from L 94, S curve 0.12, black point to L 12.5 only if below 12, no grain, no vignette

clay_lock.method: regions = whole frame, quadrants, ceiling/floor bands and the clay boxes of fixed furniture / windows / openings; peaks below ~0.03 are unreliable (weak texture), so the verdict is visual (<aid>-lock.png) with the strong-peak number as support

verdict.visual: BROKE: the room re-framed about 4-5 % taller: panelling cap at y ~0.35 vs the clay 0.39, headboard, nightstand tops and bed foot shifted down/up off the clay lines; window jamb shifted

product_check.rule: each product inside its clay box +-15 % of the box size (<aid>-boxes.png); read visually
